title.es: La producción del iPhone 18 se retrasa meses para el lanzamiento de primavera de 2027
title.en: iPhone 18 production delayed months for spring 2027 launch

body.es: Según filtraciones, la producción en masa del iPhone 18 y el 18e no comenzará hasta el 1 de enero de 2027, meses después del calendario previsto de octubre. Este retraso reduce el tiempo disponible para acumular inventario antes del lanzamiento, que se rumorea para febrero o marzo de 2027.
body.en: According to leaks, mass production of the iPhone 18 and 18e will not begin until January 1, 2027, months behind the expected October schedule. This delay reduces the time available to accumulate inventory before the launch, rumored for February or March 2027.

evidence.claim: Apple's iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e are set to begin mass production in January 2027.
This is months behind the expected October schedule.
Production of the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e won't begin until New Year's Day, 2027.
Apple doesn't need to produce the same volume of iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e handsets for launch day as it would for its more popular models.

title.es: El HomePod mini 2 en color (RED) aparece en tiendas antes de su anuncio
title.en: HomePod mini 2 in (RED) spotted in stores ahead of announcement

body.es: La versión (PRODUCT)RED del HomePod mini 2 ha sido avistada en varias tiendas con una malla roja y una etiqueta (RED) en la caja. Apple revivirá su línea (PRODUCT)RED la próxima semana, coincidiendo con el 20.º aniversario de (RED) y el Día Mundial del SIDA el 1 de diciembre.
body.en: The (PRODUCT)RED version of the HomePod mini 2 has been spotted in several stores with a red mesh and a (RED) label on the box. Apple will revive its (PRODUCT)RED line next week, coinciding with (RED)'s 20th anniversary and World AIDS Day on December 1.

evidence.claim: The (PRODUCT)RED version of the HomePod mini 2 has been spotted on display at a few stores.
The HomePod mini 2 is expected to be released by Tuesday, December 1, which is World AIDS Day.
This HomePod mini has a red mesh, and there appears to be a (RED) label on the box.
Apple is reviving its (PRODUCT)RED line next week in time for (RED)'s 20th anniversary this year.
Apple has partnered with (RED) to raise money for The Global Fund, an organization that aims to combat diseases such as HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria in Africa.

title.es: El mercado de datos para coding se dispara con la compra de datos por parte de laboratorios de frontera
title.en: Coding data market explodes as frontier labs buy training data

body.es: Un análisis reciente detalla cómo los laboratorios de IA de frontera están adquiriendo grandes volúmenes de datos de entrenamiento para mejorar sus capacidades de coding. Esta tendencia refleja la creciente importancia de los datos de alta calidad en el desarrollo de modelos de código.
body.en: A recent analysis details how frontier AI labs are acquiring large volumes of training data to improve their coding capabilities. This trend reflects the growing importance of high-quality data in code model development.

evidence.claim: Frontier labs are buying training data.

title.es: Un distrito escolar de LA bloquea las funciones de búsqueda con IA de Google
title.en: LA school district blocks Google's AI search features

body.es: Un distrito escolar de Los Ángeles ha decidido bloquear las funciones de búsqueda con IA de Google en sus dispositivos. Google sostiene que las 'AI overviews' y la búsqueda son un paquete indivisible, lo que complica la adopción parcial de sus servicios en entornos educativos.
body.en: A Los Angeles school district has decided to block Google's AI search features on its devices. Google insists that 'AI overviews' and search are a package deal, complicating the partial adoption of its services in educational environments.

evidence.claim: Google insists that AI overviews and search are a package deal.

title.es: El MacBook Air M5 alcanza su mayor descuento desde el aumento de precio
title.en: M5 MacBook Air hits its biggest discount since the price hike

body.es: El MacBook Air con chip M5 está disponible con un descuento de 300 dólares en ambas configuraciones de tamaño para el Black Friday. El modelo de 13 pulgadas con 16 GB de RAM y 512 GB de almacenamiento baja a 999 dólares, su precio más bajo desde el reciente aumento.
body.en: The M5-powered MacBook Air is available with a $300 discount in both size configurations for Black Friday. The 13-inch model with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage drops to $999, its lowest price since the recent hike.

evidence.claim: The M5 MacBook Air is $300 off in both size configurations for Black Friday.
The 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage starting at $999.
The 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage starting at $1,199.
The M5 MacBook Air is a good middle ground if you need more power than the MacBook Neo but don’t want to splurge on a MacBook Pro.
The M5 MacBook Air has a higher-resolution display, better speakers, a backlit keyboard, and faster ports.

developer_signals.author: zachlloydtweets
developer_signals.original_text:
An unexpectedly big change when using software factories is working in public.

For folks working in the old devtools paradigm, the first moment your work goes from being private to public is when you open a PR. Until then, you iterate locally, in private, using your own "cockpit" to produce code that will eventually get reviewed by a peer, pushed through CI, and then shipped out to the world.

In a software factory world, this changes; by default, you work in public, using standardized skills and tools as the default (but with the ability to tweak).

I'd argue this is good. You get more visibility into what everyone is working on. You get the ability to collaborate with teammates at the creation stage, pre-PR. You get to see how the best developers on your team use agents.

It can be uncomfortable at first, but in the long run I think it's actually a better way to work.

text.es: Zach Lloyd reflexiona sobre cómo trabajar en público es un cambio significativo al usar fábricas de software, permitiendo más visibilidad y colaboración antes de abrir un PR.
text.en: Zach Lloyd reflects on how working in public is a significant change when using software factories, allowing more visibility and collaboration before opening a PR.
